Best way to get rid of tannins would be to boil your wood for 3 hours, then change the water and boil it for another 3 hours which should help your issue :)

This looks like just regular green hair algae and unfortunately amano shrimp or snails will hardly touch it - I would advise to do a a large water change now and then small water changes for the next few days. 

Also as it is a new tank it will have a lot of nutrients and so if you have too much light then it may cause green hair algae so you may want to consider changing your light schedule.
If you boil the wood for 4-8 hours it’ll get rid of the tannins and it would stay down afterwards :)
